name: Hardcore Loot
teaser: If you hate your life and want to play Tarkov without being able to loot any of your kills, this mod is for you. Makes all dead AI unlootable. Also configurable in case you do want to loot some things.
description_html:
Please see F12 in game for configurable options.

If you enable Full Unlootable, corpses will be flagged when they are created to be unlootable. This is the Uber hardcore mode. This setting can be changed in raid, but does not retroactively apply to corpses.

Otherwise, just configure the slots you’d like to be unlootable, and the mod will adjust them to be similar to how PMC Melee weapons are, you can see but can’t touch. You are still able to loot dogtags/pockets/rig/backpack contents regardless of the slot settings. You just can’t loot the slot itself. The slot settings can be changed mid raid, and apply immediately after closing the corpse loot window. So if you really wanna cheat and loot that awesome gun, just disable the setting for the weapon slot..close the corpse loot window and open it again. Cheater.

Have fun. Masochist.

INSTALLATION

Installation

  1. Download Hardcore Loot
  2. Open the downloaded zip file in 7-zip
  3. Select the BepInEx folder in the zip file in 7-zip
  4. Drag the BepInEx folder from 7-zip into your SPT folder
